tasks.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. ONE full-body animal portrait, Isobel Draig's breathtakingly beautiful Erlenglanz horse.
Bildformat 2:3, 1024x1536. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Reference roles: image 1 erlenglanz.webp defines ONLY breed anatomy: exceptionally fine-boned, tall slender noble horse, long delicate legs, refined small head and fine arched neck, pure radiant white. Ignore humans and watercolor treatment. Image 2 Emrys defines the established illustrated Aleria horse portrait style and practical Draig tack symbolism only; do NOT copy his dark coat, age or heavy build. Image 3 is the actual House Draig heraldic DESIGN: dragon and castle motif, ivory, black and red; use as a small recognizable emblem on the saddlecloth.
Subject: a strikingly elfin but entirely natural Erlenglanz, radiant snow-white silky coat, graceful fine facial features, luminous expressive attentive eyes, proud elegant relaxed standing posture. EXPLICIT INDIVIDUAL FEATURE overriding the breed's typical short mane: a very VOLUMINOUS long flowing white-silver mane, richly sweeping down the arched neck in large graceful soft waves, and a beautiful flowing white tail. Keep true slender Erlenglanz conformation, NOT stocky workhorse anatomy, not a muscular battle charger. Beautiful and dignified, without magical horns, antlers, wings, jewelry or glowing effects.
Conservative well-kept brown leather saddle and bridle, restrained ivory saddlecloth with dark red edging and ONE small Draig dragon-and-castle heraldic patch on the visible saddle side. No armor, large drapes, elaborate metal chains, bags or weapons. No person or rider.
Quiet softly simplified pale-stone courtyard garden at Celtigerns Wacht, understated green foliage, gentle clear daylight. Horse dominates composition, three-quarter full-body view, all ears and four hooves comfortably within the frame, anatomically clear legs. Calm standing pose, not rearing or galloping. No clutter, writing, watermark, frames or collage.
tasks.notes: Atemberaubend schönes, elfenhaft filigranes weißes Pferd. Üppige lange Mähne ausdrücklich als individuelles Merkmal; kein Umbau des Rasseprofils.

tasks.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. ONE full-body animal portrait of Neithon Draig's young ADULT military riding horse, a named Ceffyl x Equo crossbreed called EIDWACHT. The animal was a gift from Owain Draig when Neithon was knighted; show a mature working cavalry mount, not a foal.
Bildformat 2:3, 1024x1536. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Reference roles: image 1 ceffyl.webp is ONLY the noble Ceffyl anatomy: tall elegant neck, fine face, strong hindquarters, intelligent loyal character. Image 2 equo.webp is ONLY the legion cavalry anatomy and demeanor: solid functional chest, durable legs, sinewy athletic musculature, disciplined calm formation posture. Ignore all riders, armor, backgrounds and watercolor treatment in those two. Image 3 Emrys is only the established Aleria anime horse art style and restrained Draig equipment colors, not the horse's identity, age or coat. Image 4 actual House Draig emblem defines the small red dragon over black castle motif on ivory for one saddle patch.
Subject: young but fully grown Ceffyl-Equo horse, solid military build yet lean and SINEWY rather than massive, fit neck, defined shoulder and tendons, proud Ceffyl elegance balanced with a legion horse's disciplined practicality. Stoic focused face, calm firm dark eyes, ears attentive, straight composed military bearing, all four hooves squarely planted as if standing at attention. No caricature angry teeth, no aggressive rearing, no sleepy expression.
VERY IMPORTANT COAT: beige base with a clearly readable natural VERTICAL DARKENING GRADIENT. Lower legs and lower belly are the lightest pale sand/cream-beige, flanks warm beige, upper shoulders, topline, high neck and head gradually darker tawny dun / muted brown. It darkens UPWARDS, NOT dark socks and NOT white neck fading to dark hooves. No pinto patches, spots or fantasy painted stripes. Short neatly trimmed dark brown mane gathered into several small close practical knots along the crest, close-cropped tidy forelock, restrained neatly kept tail. No long loose mane.
Conservative dark brown leather cavalry saddle and bridle, compact dark red saddlecloth with ONE small ivory Draig dragon-and-castle patch. Few functional straps and modest brass hardware only. No armor, chain drapes, bags, weapons, trophies, rider or lettering.
Quiet pale-stone garrison courtyard of Celtigerns Wacht with a subdued stable wall and clear daylight, simplified anime background, horse dominant in three-quarter full-body view, all ears and four hooves within frame. Avoid busy flags and ornament. One coherent 2:3 portrait, no collage, watermark or text.
tasks.notes: Jung, bereits erwachsen. Geschenk Owains zu Neithons Ritterschlag. Sehniger militärischer Körperbau, stoisch und diszipliniert; beige mit nach oben dunklerem Verlauf; kurze Knotenmähne. Benannte Zucht Ceffyl × Equo.

tasks.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. ONE full-body animal character portrait of Odyar Draig's VERY OLD black Ceffyl horse. This horse is the BROTHER of Meurig Draig's horse EMRYS in image 1, so create a visibly related but distinct individual.
Bildformat 2:3, 1024x1536. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Reference roles: image 1 is Emrys, the actual sibling and the Aleria horse portrait STYLE reference. Carry over family resemblance: long elegant face and gracefully arched long neck, large warm brown almond-shaped eyes with an old wise gentle look, related refined bone structure and long tapered ears. Do NOT copy his exact pose, lavish tack or full gray mane. Image 2 ceffyl.webp defines breed conformation ONLY: a tall noble graceful knight's horse with elegant musculature and a strong bond to its rider; ignore people and watercolor. Image 3 actual House Draig crest defines the dragon and castle emblem, red / ivory / black, use modestly on the saddlecloth.
Subject: clearly very elderly Ceffyl with a JET BLACK coat. Black mane and black tail with naturally GRAYING TIPS, silver-gray hair endings, scattered gray hairs around eyes and muzzle. Mane is long, thinner and somewhat coarse with age, mainly black at the roots and middle, gray only toward the tips; do NOT turn the whole mane white or make the coat gray. Show age in slightly hollow temples, softened drooping eyelids, modest bony cheek structure and withers, subtly dipped old back and a calm tired but dignified bearing. Old faithful noble horse, well cared for, not young, not a starving neglected animal and not a powerful aggressive charger. The kind brown eyes and head profile should clearly recall Emrys.
Quiet relaxed standing pose with all four legs visible, head held slightly lower than his brother's, a subtle relaxed hind hoof, ears calm, not galloping or rearing. Entire body, all hooves and ears within frame. No rider.
Conservative worn but carefully maintained brown leather saddle and simple bridle, a compact faded dark red saddlecloth with ONE small ivory dragon-and-castle Draig patch. A little darkened brass on buckles only, no metal armor, gold chain harness, elaborate tasseled drapes, large baggage or many emblems.
Peaceful stable courtyard of Celtigerns Wacht, low pale stone wall, soft understated stable wood, gentle daylight and uncluttered background. The old horse is the focus, three-quarter portrait composition. No text, labels, watermarks, frame or collage.
tasks.notes: Sehr alter schwarzer Ceffyl, Bruder von Meurigs Emrys. Familienähnlichkeit in Kopf, Augen und Halslinie; schwarzes Haar mit grauen Spitzen.
